text: ポケモンを　そだてて　いくと　わざを　おぼえる！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　そだてて　いくと

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく means something keeps going on from now. そだてていく = 'keep raising'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that when this happens, that follows. いくと = 'as (you) go on'.
